message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: In prison, inmate Wang X got into argument with inmate Jia, took an empty glass bottle, tried to hit Jia, police intervened, pushed him, he collided with police officer Duan, then he didn't obey, used glass bottle to hit Duan's head, causing scalp laceration.

Thus assault on police officer (civil servant). The crime likely "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) or "妨害公务" is in list: "妨害公务". Also "故意伤害" (intentional injury) because he caused injury to police. The list includes "故意伤害". Also "妨害公务" is separate.

In similar earlier example: case with QI (dangerous driving;妨害公务) where they had both dangerous driving and assault on police. That example: they had "危险驾驶;妨害公务". So they used both.

Thus here we have intentional injury to police officer, plus obstruction of official duties. The act of hitting police with bottle is both assault (故意伤害) and obstruction (妨害公务). The list includes "妨害公务". So answer likely "故意伤害;妨害公务". Check if any other relevant: "非法持有枪支" no. "暴力" not. So final.

Thus output: [罪名]故意伤害;妨害公务<eoa>
